title: GPT-6 Astra + Blender/Houdini: a 3D workflow with a separate critic agent
author: CuriAWEsity
selftext:
Hey guys, I'm a technical artist, and I've been testing GPT-6 Astra in the 3D tools I already use. I made an explorable molecular atlas in Houdini and a motor-protein animation in Blender.



This is a visualization project, but I thought the workflow would be relevant to people here building 3D scenes and assets with agents. The full 6:55 walkthrough covers the Houdini HDAs, the Codex-to-Blender connection through the Higgsfield bridge, and the development screenshots.



For the Blender scene, I used protein geometry from the PDB, then had a separate critic agent inspect renders from different angles and return a ranked list of fixes. The builder worked through three rounds of revisions. That feedback loop is the part I'd be most interested in applying to game scenes and procedural assets.



Houdini starts at 1:29, Blender at 3:31, and the critic loop at 4:09. The video also includes a comparison with a Seedance 2.5 version.



The Blender motor-core and tubulin geometry use PDB 3J8Y; the motion, stalks and cargo are illustrative. I'd love to hear what checks you'd add before using an agent-built 3D asset in a game—especially for topology, collisions and motion.
